summary: Found signs consistent with editing in 2 of 6 signals; 2 supported authenticity, 2 could not be determined.

findings.summary: One region compresses very differently from the rest.
findings.reasoning: The lower-right region shows much higher re-save error than its surroundings, which is consistent with that area coming from a different image. The image was heavily recompressed, so treat this as a hint, not proof.
findings.reliability_note: Heavy recompression weakens this signal: quality-30 re-save blurs the differences ELA looks for.

findings.summary: Camera noise looks even across the image.
findings.reasoning: The fine-grained noise left by the camera sensor is uniform, with no patch that stands out. Even noise supports authenticity but cannot rule out careful editing.
findings.reliability_note: Good light, full-resolution image; signal is trustworthy here.

findings.reasoning: No clear periodic fingerprints of splicing or AI generation stood out, but heavy recompression erases exactly those traces. Absence of evidence is not contradiction.
findings.reliability_note: Recompression at quality 30 suppresses high-frequency traces.

findings.summary: Save-history hints at two different JPEG pasts.
findings.reasoning: Background blocks carry the grid of an earlier save at a different quality than the foreground region, consistent with a composite assembled from two saves.
findings.reliability_note: Clear quantization grids on both sides of the seam.

findings.reasoning: No duplicated blocks passed the match threshold, but smooth areas like sky defeat this comparison, so a careful clone could still hide.
findings.reliability_note: Large smooth regions lower the match confidence.

findings.summary: File history and timestamps are internally consistent.
findings.reasoning: EXIF make, dimensions and chunk order agree with a single camera save, and there is no edit-software tag. Metadata is easy to forge, so this supports but never proves authenticity.
findings.reliability_note: Complete EXIF present; no C2PA manifest found (not a contradiction).
